description: A message is an object that can be received and sent to endpoints.

context.description: Message context including authorization and input plugin

correlationToken.description: Token used for correlating related messages

header.description: Message header with namespace, name, and version

auth-token.description: Port OS bearer token available to plugins during dispatch when they need to call Port OS APIs.

secrets.description: The secrets associated with the authorization link between the port OS principal and the plugin.

ownerId.description: The ID of the owner of the message

body.description: The message body, which can be any valid JSON object
